# Configuration reference

The server reads its settings from the environment (in development also from the repository's `.env`). It refuses to start
when a value is invalid and lists every problem; in production it also refuses placeholder secrets (`change-me…`).
`.env.example` has a commented example of each group, and `docker-compose.yml` passes them to the `server` container.

| Setting | Default | Type | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `NODE_ENV` | `development` | one of `development`, `test`, `production` | `production` turns on the production checks (placeholder secrets refused, JSON logs, plain http calendars refused). |
| `PORT` | `3000` | integer | Port the server listens on (inside the container: 3000). |
| `APP_URL` | **required** | URL | Public origin of the site, e.g. https://planner.example.com. Used for links in emails. |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | (unset) | comma-separated origins | Websites allowed to call this API from another origin (CORS, with cookies). The origin of APP_URL is always allowed. Leave empty when the website and the API share one origin. |
| `COOKIE_SAMESITE` | `strict` | one of `strict`, `lax`, `none` | SameSite attribute of the refresh cookie. "strict" works when the website and the API are on the same site (same origin, or subdomains of one domain such as planner.example.com + api.example.com). Only unrelated domains need "none", which requires https. |
| `OS_PLANNER_API_URL` | (unset) | string | Public address of the API as the browser sees it, if different from the website. Defaults to the apiUrl in the built web app's config.json. |
| `DATABASE_URL` | **required** | string | The MySQL database: mysql://user:password@host:3306/database. In production a default password is refused. |
| `JWT_ACCESS_SECRET` | **required** | string | Signs the short-lived access tokens (at least 32 characters). Changing it signs everybody out of their current tab until it refreshes. |
| `JWT_MEDIA_SECRET` | **required** | string | Signs the media tokens that let <img> and <video> load files (at least 32 characters, not the same as JWT_ACCESS_SECRET). |
| `SMTP_HOST` | `localhost` | string | The mail server (verification, password reset, invites, notification email). mailpit in development. |
| `SMTP_PORT` | `1025` | integer | Its port: 587 (STARTTLS) or 465 (with SMTP_SECURE=true) for most providers. |
| `SMTP_USER` | (unset) | string | Login of the mail server, if it needs one. |
| `SMTP_PASS` | (unset) | string | Password of the mail server. |
| `SMTP_SECURE` | `false` | boolean | true for implicit TLS (port 465); false lets the connection upgrade with STARTTLS. |
| `MAIL_FROM` | `OS_Planner <no-reply@os-planner.local>` | string | Sender of every email the server sends. |
| `DATA_DIR` | `./data` | string | Where uploaded files (media, attachments) and desktop releases are kept. Back it up together with the database. |
| `MAX_IMAGE_MB` | `20` | number | Largest image one upload may be, in MB. |
| `MAX_VIDEO_MB` | `500` | number | Largest video one upload may be, in MB (the reverse proxy must accept at least this much). |
| `USER_QUOTA_MB` | `2048` | number | Default storage of one person (their own notebooks, files and messages), in MB. |
| `TEAM_QUOTA_MB` | `10240` | number | Default storage of one team (its own notebooks plus all its projects). |
| `PROJECT_QUOTA_MB` | `0` | number | Default storage of one project; 0 means the project is limited only by its team. |
| `MAX_MEMBERS_PER_TEAM` | `100` | integer | Most people one team may have (an admin can set another number for a team). |
| `MAX_PROJECTS_PER_TEAM` | `50` | integer | Most projects and sub-projects one team may have. |
| `MAX_ROLES_PER_TEAM` | `100` | integer | Roles of one team, team and project roles together, @everyone not counted. |
| `AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS` | `365` | integer | Audit-log entries older than this many days are removed by the nightly job. |
| `ADMIN_EMAILS` | `` | string | Instance administrators: comma-separated email addresses. Only a verified address counts. |
| `RELEASE_TOKEN` | (unset) | string | Bearer token for POST /api/admin/releases. Empty disables the endpoint. |
| `WEB_DIST_DIR` | (unset) | string | Directory holding the built Angular app. When present the server serves it at /. |
| `TRUST_PROXY` | `false` | boolean | Set when running behind a reverse proxy so client IPs and https are detected correctly. |
| `CHROME_PATH` | (unset) | string | Chromium/Chrome/Edge binary used to render PDFs. Auto-detected in common locations when unset. |
| `PDF_NO_SANDBOX` | `false` | boolean | Needed when Chrome runs as root inside a container without a user namespace. |
| `REDIS_URL` | (unset) | string | Redis for running several server instances: realtime events reach people connected to any of them. Unset = one instance (events stay in memory). Example: redis://localhost:6379 |
| `COLLAB_DEBOUNCE_MS` | `2000` | integer | Co-editing (path /api/collab): a page is written to the database this long after the last edit (and at least this often while people keep typing). Shorter means search and exports see edits sooner, longer means fewer writes. |
| `COLLAB_MAX_DEBOUNCE_MS` | `10_000` | integer | A page being typed in without a pause is still written at least this often. |
| `COLLAB_MIGRATE_ON_START` | `true` | boolean | Builds the live document of pages that predate co-editing in the background at start-up (otherwise each is built when first opened). |
| `COLLAB_RECHECK_MS` | `20_000` | integer | How often open co-editing connections are checked against what the person may still do (events close them at once; this is the backstop). |
| `VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY` | (unset) | string | Web Push (VAPID). Generate a pair with `npx web-push generate-vapid-keys`. Without both keys push is switched off and the website hides the option. VAPID_SUBJECT is a mailto: or https: address the push services can reach you at. |
| `VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY` | (unset) | string | The private half of the VAPID key pair (keep it secret; changing it means every device subscribes again). |
| `VAPID_SUBJECT` | (unset) | string | A mailto: or https: address the push services can reach the instance operator at. |
| `PUSH_EXTRA_ENDPOINTS` | (unset) | comma-separated origins | Extra push service origins to accept, besides the browsers' own (Google, Mozilla, Apple, Microsoft). Comma-separated. |
| `NOTIFY_AWAY_SECONDS` | `600` | integer | A person with no activity on any open page for this long counts as away (email "only when I'm away"). |
| `NOTIFY_EMAIL_INTERVAL_MINUTES` | `15` | number | At most one email per chat and person in this time. |
| `NOTIFY_PUSH_COALESCE_SECONDS` | `10` | integer | At most one push per person and channel in this time. |
| `NOTIFY_SWEEP_SECONDS` | `30` | integer | How often waiting emails are looked at; 0 turns the sender off. |
| `ICS_ALLOW_HTTP` | (unset) | boolean | Calendars other people publish (ICS addresses a person follows) may be fetched over plain http://. Default: allowed outside production, refused in production (an address that starts with webcal: then uses https only). |
| `ICS_PRIVATE_ALLOWLIST` | `` | string | Hosts the calendar fetcher may reach even though they are on a private network (it refuses those otherwise, so a person cannot make the server read your internal services). Comma-separated: host, or host:port, or an IP address. Example: calendar.corp.local. |
| `EXTERNAL_CALENDAR_MAX_MB` | `5` | number | Storage one person's followed calendars may take together, in MB (a refresh that would exceed it is refused). |
| `LIVEKIT_URL` | (unset) | string | Voice and video channels need a LiveKit media server (https://livekit.io, Apache-2.0). Without all three of URL, key and secret the feature is off and the website shows no voice option. LIVEKIT_URL is the address browsers connect to (wss://…); LIVEKIT_API_URL is where THIS server reaches LiveKit's API when that differs (http://livekit:7880 inside docker); default: LIVEKIT_URL with https. The key and secret are the ones in LiveKit's own config (`keys:`); the secret must be at least 32 characters. |
| `LIVEKIT_API_URL` | (unset) | string | Where this server reaches LiveKit's API, when that differs from LIVEKIT_URL (http://livekit:7880 inside docker). |
| `LIVEKIT_API_KEY` | (unset) | string | The API key of LiveKit's config (`keys:`). |
| `LIVEKIT_API_SECRET` | (unset) | string | Its secret (at least 32 characters); the same value in LiveKit's config. |
| `VOICE_MAX_PARTICIPANTS` | `25` | integer | Most people in one voice channel unless the channel sets its own limit. |
| `VOICE_TEAM_MAX_PARTICIPANTS` | `100` | integer | Most people in all voice channels of one team at once (an admin can set another number for a team). |
| `VOICE_CHECK_SECONDS` | `30` | integer | How often the server compares who is in voice channels with the media server and re-checks their permissions; 0 turns it off. |
| `THROTTLE_DISABLED` | `false` | boolean | Turns request throttling off. Only the integration tests set this. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_FACTOR` | `1` | number | Multiplies every request limit (each route has its own per address and minute, 300 for the rest; see README "Rate limits"). 2 gives everybody twice as much room (many people behind one address), 0.5 half. |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | `log` | one of `error`, `warn`, `log`, `debug`, `verbose` | How much the server logs: error, warn, log (the default: requests, jobs, warnings), debug or verbose. |
| `LOG_FORMAT` | (unset) | one of `text`, `json` | `json` (one JSON object per line, for a log collector; the default in production) or `text` (for people; the default otherwise). |
| `LOG_REQUESTS` | `true` | boolean | One line per API request (id, method, path without its query string and secrets, status, time, who). |
| `METRICS_TOKEN` | (unset) | string | Bearer token a metrics scraper (Prometheus) uses for /api/metrics. Unset: only instance administrators' tokens are accepted. At least 32 characters. |

## Outside the server

| Setting | Where | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OS_PLANNER_API_URL` | web build (`npm run build -w @os-planner/web`) | Address of the API as browsers see it, written to `config.json` (env, then `.env`, then a question on a terminal; empty = same origin). The server reads the same variable for its CSP. |
| `OS_PLANNER_SERVER_URL` | desktop build | The website the desktop window opens (baked in; asked on first start when empty). |
| `OS_PLANNER_NO_PROMPT` | web and desktop builds | Never ask on a terminal (CI). |
| `OS_PLANNER_DOMAIN`, `OS_PLANNER_LIVEKIT_DOMAIN` | compose profile `proxy` | Host names nginx serves (the app, and the media server's signalling host). |
| `MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD`, `MYSQL_PASSWORD`, `MYSQL_PORT` | compose | The database container. |
| `LIVEKIT_WEBHOOK_URL` | compose profile `voice` | Where the LiveKit container sends its webhooks (the server's `/api/voice/webhook`). |
| `SHADOW_DATABASE_URL` | development (`prisma migrate dev`) | An empty database Prisma uses to compute migrations. |
